      Type Parameters:

      sourceCollection - the source collection

    • performWatermarkedWindowedEviction

      public static <T> EvictionMetadata<T> performWatermarkedWindowedEviction(List<T> sourceCollection, TimestampSelector<T> timestampSelector, long watermarkMs, long windowSizeMs, long everyMs, long nextWindowStartTimeMs)
      Removes items from the parameter source collection that have timestamps before the watermark. Windows whose inclusive end have passed the watermark are closed and returned as part of the eviction metadata. Windows have inclusive starts and inclusive ends.
      Type Parameters:
      T - the type of the items in the source collection
      Parameters:
      sourceCollection - the source collection.
      timestampSelector - the user's timestamp selector callback.
      watermarkMs - the calling collections watermark in milliseconds.
      windowSizeMs - the window size in milliseconds.
      everyMs - how frequently a window occurs in milliseconds.
      nextWindowStartTimeMs - the next windows start time in milliseconds. First time callers should pass the source collections start time.
      Returns:
      the nextWindowStartTimeMs. This should be saved and reused when calling performWatermarkedWindowedEviction(List, TimestampSelector, long, long, long, long)
